sources.name: JANUS_BUZZ_COLONY_MASTER_AUDIO_v36_8_RESCUE_PRIME_FULL.ino
sources.role: later embedded colony-master and recovery lineage

hive_nexus: JSON state ingestion and memory linkage
buzz_v36_8: ESP-NOW JobPacket / ShareResponse / EntropyReport packet roles
broadcast current work to voluntary workers
queue remote share responses before upstream relay
cryptographically exact Merkle-root construction and explicit byte-order handling in the historical Stratum path
separate recovery behavior for brownout/deep-battery audio state
dual-core separation of UI/audio-facing and vault/miner responsibilities

important_distinction: The audio/UI and mining functions document historical co-residency on one embedded node; they are not required semantics of the modern JANUS swarm protocol.
security_boundary: The older Hive transport had no authentication/signatures/replay prevention and is not a secure modern protocol.
Raw historical firmware is not published by this receipt because local credentials/private endpoints may be embedded in archived revisions.
Modern nodes must use current repository fencing, authority ceilings and verifier rules rather than inheriting old trust assumptions.
Historical accepted-share behavior demonstrates implementation lineage, not a claim of mining advantage.
modern_reusable_pattern: health/entropy telemetry separated from factual authority
recovery from partial subsystem failure without rewriting shared truth
